scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: A message tells Meera that her club homework has moved to a new site. The screen copies familiar colours and asks her to sign in again. Kabir compares it with the address printed on the teacher’s classroom card.
scenes.speech: A message tells Meera that her club homework has moved to a new site. The screen copies familiar colours and asks her to sign in again. Kabir compares it with the address printed on the teacher’s classroom card.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: A copied logo can make an unfamiliar page look convincing. Even a secure connection only protects the connection; it does not prove that a message or business is honest. The team needs a source beyond the message itself.
scenes.speech: A copied logo can make an unfamiliar page look convincing. Even a secure connection only protects the connection; it does not prove that a message or business is honest. The team needs a source beyond the message itself.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: The reference card is a fictional classroom example, not a page to visit. Students compare the complete host names on paper. In real use, they return through the teacher’s known route and ask before entering account details anywhere unexpected.
scenes.speech: The reference card is a fictional classroom example, not a page to visit. Students compare the complete host names on paper. In real use, they return through the teacher’s known route and ask before entering account details anywhere unexpected.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose and explain
scenes.caption: The message demands a fresh login. Its address differs from the teacher’s reference, and the class did not announce a change. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.speech: The message demands a fresh login. Its address differs from the teacher’s reference, and the class did not announce a change. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: See the consequence
scenes.caption: Return through the teacher-provided route and ask about the message. A copied appearance does not justify entering a password on an unexpected page.
scenes.speech: Return through the teacher-provided route and ask about the message. A copied appearance does not justify entering a password on an unexpected page.
scenes.dialogue: Compare an address with a supplied exact reference.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Your turn in the lab
scenes.caption: Now open the practice lab. Work through unexpected links, then address evidence, then independent routes. Test each answer, read feedback and try again when needed. Save your evidence and explain one decision in your own words.
